workflow.name: Neo Shortcut
workflow.description: Quick shortcut to trigger Claude with @neo alias

trigger.name: Ask Neo
trigger.description: Send a message to Claude (Neo) for assistance

question.label: What would you like to ask Neo?
question.placeholder: E.g., morning brief, weekly review, help

setup: 1. Open Slack and go to your workspace
2. Click on your workspace name → Tools → Workflow Builder
4. Name it 'Ask Neo' and select 'Shortcut' as trigger
usage: Use the ⚡ lightning bolt menu in Slack
